note: D00 baseline: the three profile axes (security/routing/resource) with their contract names, values, and maturity. maturity is main (merged), pr (in review), or proposal (design only) so claims stay distinguishable. No value here is production-qualified.

DEV_RAM.note: Development shared key; origins are group-key claims, not verified identities.

MEMBER_EDHOC.note: Zero-touch join with EDHOC and ledger enrollment; no Production display until qualified.

LEGACY_FIXTURE.note: Compatibility fixture, not a deployment profile; never merged with DevRam claims.

FLAT.note: Full-table flat routing; group delivery currently refuses flat (GROUP_REQUIRES_GATEWAY_SCOPED).

GATEWAY_SCOPED.note: Gateway-scoped routing for the 100-node target; group delivery requires it.

leaf-small.note: Design budget only; qualified=false in resource-profiles.json.

relay-c3.note: Design budget only; qualified=false in resource-profiles.json.

gateway-s3.note: Design budget only; qualified=false in resource-profiles.json.

capabilities.policy: additive-only: fields and methods are added, never renamed or removed without a version bump. Clients must ignore unknown fields and methods, never exact-match the document.
